description: Ash Way Pet Spa operates as a dedicated grooming facility in Everett, Washington, serving the surrounding communities since 2007. The business offers services including full grooming packages, bath and brush treatments, de-shedding, specialty breed cuts, nail trims, ear cleaning, and dental brushing, with pricing starting at $50 for small breeds and scaling by size and coat condition. Open Monday through Saturday 9AM–6PM and Sunday 12PM–6PM, the spa emphasizes one-on-one attention, breed-specific expertise, and low-stress handling with eco-friendly products and senior pet accommodations. The locally owned business is staffed by groomers with combined experience spanning nearly two decades.
